tab.title: WhatsApp
tab.description: Connect your WhatsApp number to receive and send customer messages from Business OS.
tab.connectHint: A Meta window will open. Log in with Facebook, enter your number and confirm it with the code.
tab.disconnectBody: You will stop receiving WhatsApp messages here. Message history is kept. You can connect again later.
tab.needsAttentionBody: The number is saved, but a setup step did not finish.
tab.coexistenceNote: You can keep using the WhatsApp Business app on your phone with this number.
tab.historyNote: Importing old chats and contacts is not available for this connection yet.

errors.number_not_eligible: This number isn't eligible yet. Use the WhatsApp Business app more actively and try again later.
errors.region_not_supported: This feature is unavailable for numbers from this region.
errors.business_app_update_required: Update the WhatsApp Business app to the latest version and try again.
errors.number_not_on_business_app: This number isn't registered in the WhatsApp Business app.
errors.number_already_registered: This number is registered elsewhere. Disconnect it there, wait about 15 minutes and try again.
errors.already_shared_with_partner: This WhatsApp Business account is already shared with another partner.
errors.marketing_messages_unsupported: This account uses marketing messages, which isn't supported for this connection.
errors.already_connected: This number is already connected to another company.
errors.invalid_state: The request expired. Please start again.
errors.invalid_session: WhatsApp returned an unexpected result. Please try again.
errors.unsupported_flow: WhatsApp returned an unexpected result. Please try again.
errors.code_exchange_failed: The sign-in timed out. Please try again.
errors.invalid_token: WhatsApp rejected the access. Please connect again.
errors.no_waba_access: No WhatsApp Business account was shared. Please try again and grant access.
errors.asset_mismatch: No WhatsApp Business account was shared. Please try again and grant access.
errors.ambiguous_phone_number: Several numbers were shared; select one.
errors.register_failed: Saved, but registration with WhatsApp failed. Press Retry.
errors.register_rate_limited: WhatsApp limits registration attempts. Wait a few hours and retry.
errors.subscribe_failed: Saved, but webhook subscription failed. Press Retry.
errors.not_configured: WhatsApp onboarding isn't configured on the server.
errors.provider_error: WhatsApp rejected the request. Please try again.
errors.unknown: WhatsApp rejected the request. Please try again.
errors.sdk_load_failed: Could not load the Facebook sign-in. Disable blockers and try again.
errors.popup_blocked: The sign-in window was blocked. Allow pop-ups for this site and try again.
